$comment: Deterministic per-step ceilings, measured on the committed synthetic fixture (npm run perf:fixture). Lowered as stories land: a change that lowers a number lowers it here in the same change; see README.md. The boot-bundle gzip budget is NOT here: it lives in bootBudgetPlugin (vite.config.ts). serialDepth is judged on the shallowest run and its ceiling is the deepest that has been on main, not one run; see GATES in budgets.ts. 3 Nov 2026 (#1138), re-set after the regressions since 9 Oct were fixed; what stayed was earned: dm-cold/dm-warm +1 API (touch_account_activity, hourly) and +5 chunks (the weather sky line, #1086, and modules that outgrew the 8 kB inline threshold); /npcs +2 API (kin_links for the family-links notice, which also warms the sheet's family block, #1083; open_books for the cards' in-the-book icon, #1085) and +3 chunks; dm-npc-detail +7 chunks (the Connections, Family and quick-fact sections, #1083/#1084); player-cold +3 API (character_caretakers, #1059; get_player_notice_boards for the presented board, #1064; touch_account_activity). 4 Nov 2026 (#1136): the soundboard deck docks under every DM page and shows its pads at once, so its pads, lanes, playlists and sounds are read at boot and on every resume; one batched request (lib/audio/deck/deckBatch.ts) instead of four, so dm-cold/dm-warm/resume +1 API, and dm-cold/dm-warm +2 chunks for the deck itself. dm-cold serialDepth 6 and /npcs serialDepth 2: CI measured dm-cold at 6 on main (run 41646820078) and here twice, with the deepest chain ending at embed-content/embed-monsters rather than the deck, and /npcs at 2 on main twice of three runs since #1138 (kin_links and open_books can land a wave after the list). 5 Nov 2026 (#1146): totalRequests is no longer gated, because fonts and images load or not depending on what is painted while the window is open (a Crimson Pro woff2 on dm-cold, the loading flag's bookmark-cloth.webp on dm-npc-detail); codeRequests (chunks and stylesheets) replaces it, at the counts every CI run from 3 to 5 Nov measured. serialDepth is now the minimum over runs, and pull requests run three like main: one deep run no longer fails a step. 5 Nov 2026 (Awareness Rolls): dm-cold/dm-warm +1 chunk. The rule's reading and its query joined the code the dashboard's Party widget and the Party page share, which took that common chunk (skillCheck, useActiveParty, useMemorials, cursedItems, useAwarenessRolls) to 11.6 kB, past the 8 kB inline threshold, so it is fetched once as a file instead of copied into both routes. 6 Nov 2026 (#1149): dm-cold/dm-warm +1 chunk. One initiative rule for every roll grew rules/encounterCombatLogic and rules/initiative, which the dashboard reads through the initiative widget and the party vitals, so their common chunk (encounterCombatLogic, with tokenFootprint and the turn rules) passed the 8 kB inline threshold and is fetched once as a file instead of copied into the dashboard, the encounter runner, the quest run tool and the play map. 7 Nov 2026: back to 82. #1152 (game systems) moved enough out of that chunk to bring it under the threshold again, so it is copied into its routes once more; npm run perf:code caught the drop. 13 Nov 2026 (#1179, low art): /npcs +2 chunks. The art-free card and the ledger row grew the list primitives every catalogue shares, EntityListRow (13 kB) and EntityGridCard, past the inline threshold, so each is fetched once as a file and cached for every other list instead of copied into each of the forty-odd list components that use them. CI measured 16 on main (run 43484457813) and on #1187, three runs each. 16 Nov 2026 (#1213, a campaign cadence): dm-cold/dm-warm/player-cold/resume +1 API, the session_cadences read: the regular evening decides the date the dashboard's next-session card and the Hearth show at load. The players' absences on a regular evening were a second read on every load; they are now read only when the campaign has a cadence (useSessionAbsences), so a campaign without one, like this fixture, pays nothing for them. dm-cold/dm-warm/player-cold +1 chunk: lib/calendar/nextSession grew with the cadence's evenings past the 8 kB inline threshold and is fetched once as a file, shared by the dashboard, the Hearth and the session-start dialog. Measured locally with npm run perf:budgets, three runs each, matching CI's counts on main (run 43941514217) less the absences read. Same day (#1212, table questions): player-cold +1 API, the Hearth's "Your DM asks…" reading the campaign's table questions; the unread dot shares that read and its answers rather than making its own, and the answers are read only when a question exists. The DM's dashboard pays nothing: the roll-table card reads its open questions only when it shows a table, and loads the question list and the send dialog only when needed. Measured locally with npm run perf:budgets, three runs each. 17 Nov 2026 (#1021, the AI table): player-cold +1 chunk. The table's character sheet (SoloSheet) is built from the pieces the Hearth already uses, so PlayerHpControls, until now copied into the Hearth's own chunk, is shared by two routes and is fetched once as a file. Measured locally with npm run perf:budgets, three runs each (78 78 78). 18 Nov 2026 (#1222 on #1021, the AI table's travel): dm-npc-detail +1 chunk. With the AI table's code and the travel work in one build, the bundler emits StatBlockPanel (4.2 kB) as a file of its own, shared by the monster sheet, the NPC tabs and the wildshape preview, instead of copying it into each of them; neither branch alone does (24 on each, and #1220 found none on main). One more request on the NPC page, fetched once and cached for the other sheets. Measured locally with npm run perf:budgets, three runs (25 25 25). To check again when the table epic and travel are both on main: if CI measures 24 there, this goes back. 19 Nov 2026 (#1021, the casting branch): dm-cold/dm-warm 83 to 81 and player-cold 78 to 76 chunks. With the casting work in the build the bundler copies two small shared modules into their routes again instead of emitting them as files; no code was removed to earn it, so if a later change takes them past the 8 kB inline threshold they come back. Measured locally with npm run perf:budgets, three runs each. serialDepth is left alone: its ceiling is the deepest main has measured, not one local run. 19 Nov 2026 (#1021 row 27, the Level Plan): dm-nav /quests +1 API, level_milestones with its steps, the one read the strip above the board needs to say where the party's next level comes from. The party is read only when a next milestone exists (or by experience), and the encounter reads behind its fight warnings only when there is a milestone to check, so this fixture, which has none, pays nothing for them. Measured locally with npm run perf:budgets, three runs (5 5 5). 20 Nov 2026 (#1226, the campaign's canon): dm-npc-detail +1 API and +1 chunk, the sheet's "Canon here" block (the clues lying on this NPC and the lore that comes out from them, one read through get_canon_here, which replaced three campaign-wide reads of the canon) and its component; player-cold +2 API, the journal's shared The World tab lights its unread dot at boot from get_player_canon and get_player_lore_passages (the truths, lore and passages told to this character). dm-cold and dm-warm serialDepth lowered to 4, as measured: the shallowest of three runs was 2. Same day (#1226 story 10, backstories written together): player-cold +1 chunk. The journal's My story tab and The World tab share the player's canon reads (usePlayerCanon, with the unread dot that boots the Hearth), which the bundler now fetches once as a file instead of copying into each route; the chunk was not isolated by hand, so if a later change brings it back under the inline threshold this goes back. Measured locally with npm run perf:budgets, three runs (77 77 77). 23 Nov 2026 (#1255, the Canon review): dm-npc-detail 25 to 23 chunks, as CI measured on the pull request (run 45177118747). Which two files went was not isolated; nothing was removed from the sheet to earn it, so the likeliest cause is the bundler copying two small shared modules into their routes instead of emitting them as files, and a later change may bring them back. Same change: dm-cold/dm-warm 81 to 82 and player-cold 77 to 78 chunks. The AI's shared text helpers (ai/utils with the rich-text reader, 4.3 kB) were copied into fifteen lazy chunks on main; with the Canon review's work in the build the bundler emits them once as a file (utils), and that file is in the preload list of the image-generation code the dashboard and the Hearth load, so it is one more request there, fetched once and cached for every generator panel. Found by building main beside the branch and comparing chunk names: utils is the only file the branch adds. Why the bundler stopped copying a chunk under the 8 kB inline threshold was not isolated; if a later build copies it again, these go back. CI measured 82 82 82 and 78 78 78 (run 45178239648). Same day, merging main (Ask Grimoire as merged) into the Canon review: player-cold 78 to 77 chunks, as npm run perf:code measured on the merged build; the utils chunk the review had emitted as a file is copied into its routes again. If a later build emits it once more, this goes back.
